display_name: Superior Attuned Superior Scourging Blast B
help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Enhances the damage of a power by {Boost.Attrib.Damage.Scale}% and reduces recharge time by {Boost.Attrib.Recharge.Scale}%.    This enhancement can only be slotted by Corruptors and may be slotted into any Corruptor damage power.
